bio: The Great House Hotel a beautiful grade II* listed building is a luxury 3 star hotel in Bridgend . Originating from around 1550, the hotel is believed to have been a gift from HRH Queen Elizabeth 1 to the Earl of Leicester who used it as a hunting lodge.  The hotel is located in the pretty conservation village of Laleston, Bridgend, and is now one of the leading hotels in Bridgend . Located just 10 minutes from the seaside town of Porthcawl and 25 minutes equidistant between Cardiff and Swansea.  The Great House Hotel plays host to the 2 AA Rosette-awarded Leicester Restaurant. Enjoy Afternoon Tea in an historical setting filled with flagstone floors, inglenook fireplaces and oak beams.  Guests at Leicester Restaurant are treated to an elegant, traditional selection. You can enjoy homemade cakes and buttery shortbread, as well as scones with lashings of preserves and clotted cream, and fresh finger sandwiches.  Afternoon Tea is served 3pm to 5pm every day. When booking, please specify 'Afternoon Tea' in the Special Requests box on the online booking form.
